title: Noodling Nudibranch
statement: This soft, lantern-frilled sea slug spends its days thoughtfully rearranging bits of sea glass on the moonlit sand, pausing over each piece as if weighing it carefully, and its cerata ripple with a fresh shimmer of color whenever two pieces finally fit just right. It is in no hurry, and it asks only that you watch long enough to see a pattern emerge.
